description.value: Codes used to categorize requirements statements from the Requirements resource. These requirements apply to actors which are usually computer systems. However, actors may also be organizations, devices, individuals, or other entities.

definition.value: Categories related to how the actor behaves
Requirements relating to the business operations of the actor or the entities responsible for the actor
Requirements related to what the actor does (inputs turned into outputs)
Requirements relating to when, how, or what data is exchanged with other actors
Requirements related to how data must be analyzed, transformed, considered, or otherwise used by an actor
Requirements related to if or how data is persisted by an actor
Requirements related to the manner in which the actor accomplishes functional requirements
Requirements related to how and when an actor needs to be reachable and useable
Requirements related to how data is collected from and exposed to humans (or animals) by the actor
Requirements around a computer system's user interface that ensure a satisfactory experience for users from different backgrounds or with varying physical, cognitive, and/or sensory abilities
Requirements around ensuring that different computer system implementations have sufficiently aligned appearance and mechanisms of interaction
Requirements related to the intuitiveness, simplicity, and ease-of-use of a computer system's user-interface
Requirements that ensure that data is appropriately protected from threats and respects rules around what parties are permitted to access or manipulate
Requirements that ensure that actor processes do not negatively impact the wellbeing of people or assets
Requirements that deal with timeliness of processing and/or responsiveness under differing levels of load/volume for an actor
Categories related to where the requirement came from
Requirements originating from the community of individuals expected to use the system/solution
Requirements originating from regulation or law
Requirements documenting decisions made in the design of the solution
